title: Revisiting Stromal Cell Markers in Dental Pulp and Apical Papilla Cells
html: STRO-1 remains a widely used odontogenic mesenchymal stromal cell (MSC) marker, yet its ambiguous expression, non-specific tissue distribution, and unsolved structural features continue to raise questions. This study aimed to systematically characterize STRO-1 expression in human dental pulp stromal cells (hDPSCs), stromal cells from the apical papilla (SCAPs), and their native tissues, alongside CXCR4 as a biologically relevant reference marker associated with dental pulp injury and repair.
